metadata.counting_caliber: system_prompt + user_prompt joined by newline, matching exactly what the probe battery sends to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (system message + user message). Measured with transformers AutoTokenizer (ChatGLM4Tokenizer, trust_remote_code) using encode(..., add_special_tokens=False), because this model ships tokenization_chatglm.py + tokenizer.model rather than a HuggingFace tokenizers-library tokenizer.json (so reference_server Tokenizer.from_pretrained cannot load it and remains in labeled stub mode for live serving).
metadata.note: Real prompt-token counts measured with the THUDM/glm-4-9b-chat tokenizer via transformers AutoTokenizer from HF_ENDPOINT=hf-mirror. Behavioral distributions are NOT captured (no local generation); for open-source behavioral references see the Zenodo 165-model fingerprint dataset (CC-BY-4.0) cited in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Tokenization is deterministic, so samples are identical by construction. IMPORTANT: with no behavioral reference, verify can only certify tokenizer-family consistency and must NOT output verdict=pass; it caps at insufficient_evidence.
